entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That old man must be Ono! Let's stop him[n]before he causes any more trouble for[n]others!

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: Who the hell are you people! Do you[n]have some problem with me, Heiji Ono!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's the first thing out of his mouth...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But it seems like this is the old guy who's[n]making trouble in Kichijoji!

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: Nice, I can tell you're annoyed even with[n]your masks on!

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: That shows how interested you are in[n]me, Heiji Ono, right? Riiight?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...He's certainly disturbed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let's end this, Joker!

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: Yes, yes, get mad! Look at me, Heiji Ono!

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: ...It started with something small.

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: Whenever I'd do something stupid,[n]my family would worry about me.

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: My son usually treats me like I'm worthless,[n]but he would care for me in those times...

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: It felt so good that I started seeking that[n]kind of affection everywhere. I ended up[n]causing so much trouble...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: An unfortunate consequence of isolation...

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: *sniff* I've caused so much trouble...[n]How am I supposed to live like this?
By apologizing.
In any way you can.

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: Apologize? It's too late for that...

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: No, the important thing is to start making[n]up for it...

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: You speak with some brutal honesty, kid...

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: But you're right. I'll start by making up for[n]what I did.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm certain that's what your family[n]wishes as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And from now on, instead of taking it out[n]on others, you should communicate your[n]needs directly to your family.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Tell them that you're "lonely" before it's[n]too late.

entries.speaker: Shadow Ono
entries.en: Yeah, I'll do that...
